title: Inference termination classifier and incident insights UX
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a deterministic 'termination classifier' signal across tracing, logs and metrics so we can attribute request terminations to concrete causes (client cancel, client timeout, API-gateway timeout, overload/buffer-drop, model error, kernel OOM, gRPC/HTTP error codes, network reset). Build a dashboard and alerting views that show termination distributions by model variant, route, region, capacity tier and SLA slice. This work ties tracing hook additions, log pipeline enrichments, and a new per-request classification step in the telemetry pipeline. Goal: reduce MTTI for client-visible failures and uncover workload-specific overload/timeout patterns that current SLOs miss.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing: new span attribute "termination.reason" emitted at request end for all runtime entry points (http/gRPC/edge proxy) and documented in tracing schema
Logs: enrichment step tags existing request logs with termination.reason and termination.code where present; verified via Kibana/ES samples
Metrics: new histogram "termination_latency_ms" partitioned by termination.reason available in Metrics pipeline and visible in Grafana
Dashboard: interactive 'Termination Insights' dashboard showing top 10 termination reasons by model, route, and region for last 24h and 7d; supports filtering to Dedicated vs Hosted traffic
Alerts: SLO-alert rule(s) that target increases in 'model-error' and 'overload' terminations above baseline with runbook links
Tests: synthetic harness simulating client-cancels, timeouts, overload drops and model exceptions with automated validation in CI
notes: Implementation split: (1) tracing hook changes in runtime request-finish path; (2) classifier in log pipeline (kstreams) that uses last-span attributes + response codes; (3) dashboard/alert authoring in Grafana/Alertmanager
Trade-offs: adding termination metadata increases trace header size and log payloads; prefer concise enum values and rely on sampling for full payload traces
Privacy: do not include PII in termination.reason; classifier must not leak prompt contents — only signals derived from status codes and runtime events
Backwards compatibility: older traces without termination.reason should be mapped to 'unknown' and surfaced separately in dashboard
Fallback: if classifier is unavailable, we still emit raw error codes; dashboard will show an 'unclassified' bucket
Rollout plan: feature-flag initial tracing attribute; enable log enrichment for 10% of traffic in staging, then 50%, then 100% pending metrics stability

decision_record: Use compact enum values for termination.reason: client_cancel, client_timeout, gateway_timeout, overload_drop, model_error, kernel_oom, http_error, grpc_error, network_reset, unknown
Emit termination.code for numeric details (HTTP status or gRPC code) as optional second attribute
Classifier surface must be available in traces, logs and metrics to support drilldown from dashboards into traces without expensive sampling increases
